quote: Upon those highways which have official traffic-control devices permitting angle parking, a person shall not stop, stand or park a vehicle other than at the angle to the curb or edge of the highway indicated by such devices.

activation.condition: Official device permits angle parking on the governed highway and vehicle is stopped, standing or parked

obligation.description: Stop, stand or park at an angle other than the device-indicated angle to the curb or highway edge
obligation.source_clause: shall not stop, stand or park a vehicle other than at the angle to the curb or edge of the highway indicated by such devices

timing.description: During the stopped, standing or parked interval; no numeric tolerance appears in source law
